title: Settings
description: Manage your account profile and system users.

users.title: Users
users.cannotDeleteAdmin: Cannot delete the main admin user.
users.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete user {{username}}?

roleHints.admin: Everything, including users, backups and the host firewall.
roleHints.operator: Networks, devices, groups and VPN rules; no users or host firewall.
roleHints.viewer: Read-only; can change only their own password.

backups.title: Backups
backups.description: Database and WireGuard configs. Backups contain private keys: keep downloads safe.

notifications.title: Telegram notifications
notifications.description: Create a bot with @BotFather, add it to your chat, then enter the bot token and the chat ID.
notifications.tokenStored: Stored — leave empty to keep it

events.node_offline: A device goes offline or comes back
events.quota_exceeded: A device uses 80% or all of its traffic quota

errors.chatIdRequired: Enter the chat ID to enable notifications.
errors.botTokenRequired: Enter the bot token to enable notifications.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Logins that are still valid. End one to sign that browser out.
sessions.endOwnConfirm: End your own session? You will be signed out.

vpnPool.title: VPN address pool
vpnPool.description: Every device config routes this one block; networks are made inside it. So new networks, rules and groups never need a new config on any device — the server decides who reaches whom.
vpnPool.label: Address pool
vpnPool.warning: Choose it once. Changing it later means every device downloads its config again.
vpnPool.confirm: Change the address pool to {{pool}}? Every device will need to download its config once more.

endpointHost.title: Server address (domain)
endpointHost.description: The name every device config reaches the hub by. With a domain, moving the server to a new IP changes only the DNS record — no device needs a new config.
endpointHost.label: Domain or IP
endpointHost.usingIp: Empty: configs use the server IP {{ip}}.
endpointHost.warning: Point the domain’s A record at this server first. Changing this means every device downloads its config once more.
endpointHost.confirm: Change the server address in every device config? Every device will need to download its config once more.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description_text: Make your own roles: for each section choose hidden, view or change, and if you like the networks the role is limited to. Then give the role to users under Users.
roles.empty: No custom roles yet. Admin, Operator and Viewer are always there.
roles.name: Name

sectionHints.dashboard: The overview page and server stats.
sectionHints.networks: Network list and pages; edit: DNS, restart, create and delete.
sectionHints.devices: Device list and pages; edit: add, rename, expire, delete, new key.
sectionHints.configs: Download configs, QR codes and install scripts — they hold private keys.
sectionHints.groups: Device groups; edit: create, change members.
sectionHints.vpn_rules: Rules between networks, the matrix and "Who can reach whom?"; edit: write rules.
sectionHints.limits: Speed limits and quotas; edit: profiles and who they cover.
sectionHints.host_firewall: View the server firewall (changes stay with admins).
sectionHints.fail2ban: View bans and logs (changes stay with admins).
sectionHints.audit: Who did what in the panel.

roles.adminOnlyNote: Always admins only, whatever the role: server administration, users and roles, backups, tunnel changes and host firewall changes.
roles.scopedNote: Only the chosen networks: the role keeps Networks, Devices and Device configs, inside these networks only. Sections that show several networks at once are off.
